name: Almana Hospital
note: Almana General Hospitals are owned and operated by Ebrahim Mohammed Almana & Brothers Co. (Eastern Province). PIF's Sanabil Investments acquired 20% of that company in February 2016 (claim almana-sanabil-pif-stake); no divestment found since. Front sponsor of Al-Khaleej (2026-27 kit). The PR proposes Concern; a maintainer sets the tier.
